# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_credentials (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_credentials" "example_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_credentials" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  deployment_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
  username = "username"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)

### Optional

- `deployment_id` (String) Filter to credentials attached to this deployment
- `direction` (String) Sort direction (default: asc)
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "username", "created_at", "updated_at".
- `username` (String) Filter by username (case-insensitive substring match)

### Read-Only

- `result` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result))

<a id="nestedatt--result"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID
- `updated_at` (String)
- `username` (String) Login presented by the client. Printable ASCII only, excluding space and colon (RFC 7617 forbids a colon in the user-id).
